response: When dealing with eyelid-parotid metastasis, it is essential to screen for coexisting masses in both the periocular and parotid areas. This is because tumors can present simultaneously or sequentially in these structures, and either area could be the primary or metastatic site. Routine assessment of both areas is crucial for oculoplastic and parotid surgeons to ensure comprehensive evaluation and appropriate management of patients presenting with a mass in either the eyelid or parotid gland.
